##### Project general facts

The Cube Residences is a modern low-rise residential project offering a collection of thoughtfully designed units for comfortable urban living. Arranged over a basement, ground floor, upper residential floors and a rooftop, the development combines contemporary architecture with functional design. The ground floor enhances daily life with a co-working space for professionals, a lounge with a coffee cart, a concierge reception desk and round-the-clock security.

On the rooftop, The Cube Residences offers recreational amenities that promote a healthy and social lifestyle. Residents can enjoy a rooftop pool, a fitness club, a sauna with showers and a gaming room, creating a well-rounded living experience in which every element supports balance and well-being.

Every residence features modern finishing with high-quality materials and is delivered fully furnished with a fully equipped kitchen. Smart home technology is integrated throughout, offering effortless control and enhanced comfort, while contemporary interiors create spaces that are both functional and inviting.

##### Location description and benefits

Meydan City is a dynamic and ambitious development known for its blend of luxury, leisure and cutting-edge infrastructure, positioned close to Burj Khalifa and Downtown Dubai. The district is home to high-end residential communities, office spaces and world-class leisure attractions, including Meydan Racecourse, home of the Dubai World Cup.

The area enjoys excellent connectivity via Al Khail Road and Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed Road, ensuring swift access to other parts of Dubai. It offers a diverse range of homes, from modern apartments to luxury villas, alongside golf courses, parks, fine dining and a marina, while the Meydan One Mall project adds world-class retail and entertainment.

Meydan City combines modern convenience, strategic connectivity and a prime Dubai address, making it one of the city's most visionary urban environments. Its mix of luxury living, sports and entertainment supports steady demand from residents and investors.
